theme: Light mode default (with Dark mode toggle). Concept: 'Old Money Tech' meets 'Mom-and-Pop Warmth'.

rules: NEVER use generic sans-serif (Inter, Roboto) for headings.
Use JetBrains Mono for ALL monetary values and data points to emphasize precision and 'money-first' hierarchy.
Use Cormorant Garamond for main section titles to bring 'restaurant menu' authenticity.
Use tight letter spacing for headings, wide tracking for overlines.
Use #27AE60 (Deep Forest Green) exclusively for money-made, ROAS, and successful metrics.
Never use pure black or pure white; always tint with warmth (Beige/Bone tones).
Limit brand primary color to key conversion actions.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.

grid_modes.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Widget span logic applied.
grid_modes.marketing_bento: The 'Tetris' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12). Wide gaps (gap-8).

layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, data grids, and dense content. Center-align hero metrics when they are the sole focus.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background (#FFFFFF or #F4F1EA). 1px subtle border (#E8E6DF). NO heavy drop shadows. Sharp or subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius).
surfaces.headers: Solid Background with a hard bottom border if content cuts off, or Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFCF8]/80) if content scrolls under.
surfaces.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle ambient shadow (shadow-sm), border color darkens on hover.

component_strategy.general: Use Shadcn/UI for logic (forms, dialogs, tables) but deeply customize the styling to match the 'Mom-and-Pop Warmth' + 'Premium' aesthetic.
component_strategy.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn). Minimal grid lines, focus on the trend (Green for ROAS). Remove redundant axes if context is clear.
component_strategy.tables: Dense, highly legible rows. JetBrains Mono for all numeric columns. Right-align money columns.
component_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or max 8px radius. Use transform transitions (active:scale-95). ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.

global_dashboard.hierarchy: Money-first. Top left must be a massive 'Total Attributed Revenue' counter.

content_director.asset_vault: Masonry or Bento grid of thumbnail images.
content_director.prompt_card: Editorial layout, looks like a physical recipe card.
content_director.brutal_critic: High contrast grade badges. WEAK (Red #C0392B), MODERATE (Yellow #F39C12), IMPROVABLE (Blue #2980B9), STRONG (Green #27AE60). Blunt typography for verdicts.

adsmith.strategy_comparison: A/B split view. Highlight the 'ROAS Winner' dynamically.
adsmith.learning_chart: Week-over-week Recharts line chart showing the 50/50 -> 70/30 -> 80/20 budget shift.

echolink.coupon_wheel: Visually gamified element. (Consider Spline or Framer Motion 3D spin effect).
echolink.rfmd_table: Shadcn data table with VIP segments highlighted.

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements.
Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
Staggered entrance animations for grid items using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure min 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='roas-metric').

icons.library: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react (for premium duotone). Provide command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react if used.

chef_cooking.context: Content Director - Asset Vault (Chef working in commercial kitchen)

kitchen_prep.context: Content Director - Asset Vault (Baker preparing dough)

customers_eating.context: EchoLink - Scan to Spin / VIP Segments (People dining at cafe)

storefront.context: AdSmith - Organic Community Outreach (Mom and pop storefront)

food_close_up.context: AdSmith - Paid Local Velocity (Delicious pasta close up)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI components (.js extensions).
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Implement the EXACT color hex codes and font families provided. Do not invent new colors.
Apply `data-testid` to all buttons, links, inputs, and key metric displays.
Use Recharts for the AdSmith week-over-week ROAS chart, heavily styled to match the warm/premium aesthetic.
For the 'Brutal Honesty Video Critic', use stark, high-contrast badges and typography to emphasize the bluntness.
Never apply `transition: all`. Use specific CSS transitions.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers or dropdowns. Use the specified surface colors.
Load 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Manrope', and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, customized to match the theme.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; prefer flat solid surfaces for data clarity in this specific design.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Always add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.
